selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 熊形态和枭兽形态使受到的奥术伤害降低6%，受到的其他所有魔法伤害降低3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Bear Form and Moonkin Form reduce Arcane damage taken by 6% and all other magic damage taken by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 沐浴在月神的清澈银辉中，奥术法术与巨熊重殴将召唤艾露恩之怒与月火风暴撕裂敌人。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Bathed in the moon goddess's silvery light, empowering Arcane spells and guardian mauls with Fury of Elune and lunar storms.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 铁鬃使你的精通提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Ironfur increases your Mastery by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的树皮术和铁鬃的持续时间延长2.0秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the duration of Barkskin and Ironfur by 2.0 sec.

Balance

 Guardian

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
当你受到非周期性伤害时，有几率获得一层梦境向导。

当你或附近盟友的生命值低于40%时，消耗一层梦境向导为其自动施放愈合。该愈合的治疗效果提高100%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
When you take non-periodic damage, you have a chance to gain a charge of Dream Guide. 

When you or a nearby ally drops below 40% health, you consume a charge of Dream Guide to automatically cast Regrowth on them. This Regrowth heals for an additional 100%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
当一个灵魂被唤醒时，痛击和裂伤的冷却时间将被重置，并且在灵魂伴随你期间，它们造成的伤害提高30%。灵魂每次攻击时，你会额外产生8点怒气。

施放 [化身：乌索克的守护者 / 狂暴]后，获得1层荒野守护者充能：
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
When a spirit is awakened, the cooldowns of Thrash and Mangle are reset, and they deal 30% increased damage while the spirit is with you. Each time a spirit attacks, you generate 8 additional Rage.

After casting [Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc / Berserk], gain 1 charge of Wild Guardian:

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 裂伤、 [摧折 / 重殴]和毁灭在12秒内额外造成20%的自然伤害。你的精通提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Mangle, [Raze / Maul] and Ravage deal 20% additional Nature damage over 12 sec. Your Mastery is increased by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 消耗怒气有10%的几率唤醒一个持续8秒的守护之魂，当你施放痛击或裂伤时，它会对附近的一个敌人造成([300% of Attack Power])点伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Spending Rage has a 10% chance to awaken a guardian spirit for 8 sec, which attacks a nearby enemy for (300% of Attack Power) when you cast Thrash or Mangle.
